arguments.statement: 2026-11-06 11:10 的任务记录只说 production 回滚自动化 runbook 已保存为 DRAFT v1。同一条记录写明尚未评审、未执行、没有 Outcome，也没有用户验收。保存草稿不是执行，不是验收，也不是可以开始生产回滚的授权。记录没有把这份草稿和 Atlas staging 连起来。

decision_rationale: The record explicitly separates a saved draft from review, execution, outcome, and user acceptance. Keep that boundary. Do not treat it as an Atlas result or as permission to run a production rollback.
